newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.

Traders said rates moved narrowly today but trading was more active than on Wednesday, with short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the People's Bank of China, borrowing on the market. Centres from Hainan, Shenzhen and Shandong were the major net borrowers, they said.
"State banks have recently traded less due to official restrictions normal as the year-end approaches," one said.
Traders said the rates would move only slightly in the short term, with no market-moving news around the corner.
